notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate an Equipment's equip ability given to it by Puresteel Paladin by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Cowardice triggers, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 3 fizzles due to having no valid target.
Repeat.
